fieldValues.title: The stakes
fieldValues.article_text: What it changes and for whom, what it forecloses, whether it can be undone, and what would make the recommendation wrong. Checked by: mechanical for presence; judgement for substance.
fieldValues.rationale: From SP-91: judging needs the question, the stakes and the real options. The last clause is what the owner lacks when only clicking 'recommended' is possible.
